title: Compare agent effort on comparable runs

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** Existing maintained proof detects double-charging when one comparison group combines stored-only and native selections of the same task.

Story: `SEED-345#compare-agent-effort-on-comparable-runs`, completed product revision `0ffdf58012bc210423868326e252042192c2332b`. The source promises that repeating a selection cannot double-charge responses while retaining each execution's figures. This check covers mixed stored/native session overlap with a disjoint stored worker; it makes no broader completeness claim.

The isolated detached checkout was `/tmp/dough-ic-345-scratch-1794830672434`. It reused the execution checkout's installed dependencies through one owned symlink. The pre-probe state contained only that untracked symlink. No execution-checkout source or test was changed.

The maintained check was `dashboard/backend-tests/usage-history/agent-effort-group-coverage.spec.ts`, “same-session stored counters cannot double-charge native evidence and disjoint stored workers survive.” Its unchanged MakeMe setup records native root input20 and worker input30, imports them, then compares repeated stored-only selections with native root evidence. Each execution retains input50. Correct group accounting retains root20 plus the disjoint stored worker30, for input50 and requests2.

Focused runner, executed from the scratch checkout:
`caffeinate -s -i npx playwright test --config dashboard/backend.playwright.config.ts dashboard/backend-tests/usage-history/agent-effort-group-coverage.spec.ts --grep 'same-session stored counters' --reporter=list`

Baseline passed exactly one selected test. One temporary fault in `dashboard/server/agentEffortComparisonGroup.ts:63` changed `if (nativeSessions.has(group.sessionId))` to `if (false && nativeSessions.has(group.sessionId))`, bypassing only the stored/native overlap exclusion. Fixtures and assertions stayed unchanged. The same focused check failed at the maintained `totals.totalInput` assertion on line153: expected50, received70. Earlier per-execution figures remained50/50/50.

A separate actual-CLI witness using the same existing builders and source boundary independently observed correct input50/requests2 before the fault and wrong input70/requests3 under it, with per-execution input50/50/50 preserved. The extra20 is the already-selected native root counted again from stored counters. This establishes the intended path and wrong behavior independently of the maintained assertion failure.

The source was restored byte-for-byte in a finally block. `git diff --exit-code` against the selected revision confirmed both product and test unchanged; the post-probe status matched the pre-probe status. The same focused check passed exactly one test after restoration. The owned dependency symlink and scratch worktree were removed successfully. Only temporary witness/log/report files remain outside the execution checkout.

Next proof action: retain the existing overlap regression; this observation needs no new or stronger proof and no repair. It confirms the execution's existing G14 correction/disposition rather than creating a new product change.

- **Test runtime.** Measured test-case durations: baseline335ms, fault571ms, restored591ms, total1497ms, from Playwright output. Baseline runner3.6s and restored runner1.6s were printed; the fault runner did not print a total runtime.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no separate human-effort measurement was supplied or taken.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable: no token or other independent agent-effort measurement was available; elapsed time is reported separately.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 186162 ms (measured), from 1794830672434 to 1794830858596 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: revision0ffdf58012bc210423868326e252042192c2332b — Caught; no follow-up. Retain the existing mixed stored/native overlap regression.
